mappingOptions.strength: A clear learning → making → reference → career journey, with the teaching inquiry CTA at the main public landmark.
mappingOptions.risk: Hall is not mapped to the literal gallery page.

mappingOptions.strength: Exhibition Hall → gallery is immediately literal.
mappingOptions.risk: Archive → teaching weakens the archive/reference meaning and moves the primary inquiry path away from the landmark.

preferredMapping.reason: It makes the teaching offer discoverable at the public landmark while retaining a distinct concept-library role for Harbor Archive. It is neither implemented nor approved.

interactionModels.flow: approach → named prompt → E/Enter or visible click/tap → existing HTML page → browser Back; explicit World return remains a later decision
interactionModels.mobile: visible prompt must provide a large touch target
interactionModels.tradeoff: Lowest content duplication and preserves existing pages; context switch and explicit return affordance need later approval.

interactionModels.flow: approach → prompt → accessible panel summary → optional existing page → close returns to same place
interactionModels.tradeoff: Strong return continuity; needs content curation, accessibility work, and a new runtime UI.

interactionModels.flow: approach → prompt → separately loaded content scene/area → explicit return seam
interactionModels.mobile: scene entry CTA plus back control
interactionModels.tradeoff: Most spatially expressive; highest art/runtime cost and risks making navigation a barrier to portfolio content.

currentRoutingEvidence.worldScene: portfolio-world/src/world/destinationNavigation.mjs and WorldScene.ts use forecourt plus E/Enter or pointer activation and assign existing page URLs.
currentRoutingEvidence.canonicalR4: portfolio-world/src/scenes/CanonicalRuntimeR4Scene.ts emits canonical-interaction only; it does not navigate to HTML.
currentRoutingEvidence.r5: No R5 interaction, return UI, or page routing implementation exists.

viewport.method: Every comparison uses one world-coordinate transform for both scenery and player; boards are plans, not runtime captures.

worldScaleOptions.benefit: Keeps the composed Candidate B view coherent and minimizes new authored terrain.
worldScaleOptions.risk: Very limited camera travel; player can feel small and exploration shallow.

worldScaleOptions.description: Larger logical harbor around an authored 1280×720 core.
worldScaleOptions.benefit: Meaningful following camera and stronger local exploration.
worldScaleOptions.risk: Requires new edge terrain, water, walk surfaces, and camera-safe art; master must not simply be scaled.

worldScaleOptions.description: Keep harbor core bounded; use approved seams for Hero interior or future areas as separate scenes.
worldScaleOptions.benefit: Preserves current composition and makes future content additive.
worldScaleOptions.risk: Transitions and state/return contracts are required; main harbor remains compact.

cameraOptions.assessment: Maximum context; player can lack presence.
Preferred first gameplay test: player presence improves while a nearby route and landmark remain visible.
Improves player read without closer scenery but applies greater visual/corridor pressure.

playerScaleOptions.geometryNote: C.2 validates 32-unit collision width and 48-unit minimum corridor clearance; a 64-unit recommended-width reading remains PASS_OR_WARN, not an automatic visual-scale approval.

futureExpansionModels.description: Author new east world geometry, water/shore artwork, routes, and camera bounds beyond the current harbor.
futureExpansionModels.benefit: Continuous sailing/harbor movement is possible later.
futureExpansionModels.risk: Highest rework risk; must not imply current reserve is pre-existing land.

futureExpansionModels.description: Keep harbor complete; enter separately authored Hero interior or offshore area from an approved threshold.
futureExpansionModels.benefit: Protects Candidate B composition and contains future production scope.
futureExpansionModels.risk: Requires loading, state, and return-location design.

expansionSeams.current: boarding threshold only; no deck/interior access
expansionSeams.activation: Human approval plus authored interior, interaction, loading, collision, and return review
